name: vamet
description: vAMET - Virtual Aeromet panel for virtual air traffic controllers.
author: DookthorAndriss

scripts.build:exe: npm run build:all && npx esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=sea/main.js && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(process.execPath, 'vAMET.exe')" && npx postject vAMET.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB sea/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
